# specification-genesis-boundary

> Minimal, domain-agnostic Coq 8.18.0 formalization of the structural boundary between informal semantic intent, candidate formal specifications, and machine-checked derivations or implementations (`Print Assumptions == ∅`, `coqchk -o`, `MIT OR Apache-2.0`).

This repository provides constructive, axiom-free Coq 8.18.0 models demonstrating why mechanical proof checking of a formal specification does not by itself establish real-world semantic adequacy, and how multi-axis evidence admission prevents epistemic laundering.

## Core Formal Theories (`theories/`)

- [theories/Boundary.v](theories/Boundary.v): Defines observation-limited indistinguishability (`indistinguishable_inputs_force_error`) and conditional assurance transfer (`assurance_requires_semantic_fidelity`) across abstract requirement, observation, specification, and world types.
- [theories/EvidencePolicy.v](theories/EvidencePolicy.v): Defines `ClaimRecord` and the deterministic admission predicate `admissible_claim`, proving `no_epistemic_laundering`, `formal_proof_preserved_when_scoped`, and `spec_mutation_invalidates_adequacy`.
- [theories/Countermodels.v](theories/Countermodels.v): Provides a constructive finite countermodel (`checked_spec_can_misrepresent_intent`) showing a syntactically accepted specification can violate semantic fidelity under lossy observation.
- [theories/Ledger.v](theories/Ledger.v): Provides section-parameterized trust accounting (`end_to_end_ledger_accounting`) that closes with zero global axioms while exposing `conforms` and `faithful` as explicit theorem premises.

## Verification & Differential Parity Harness (`tests/`)

- [tests/AuditAssumptions.v](tests/AuditAssumptions.v): Verifies the generalized type signature of `end_to_end_ledger_accounting` and runs `Print Assumptions` across all 7 exported theorems.
- [tests/RejectPromotion.v](tests/RejectPromotion.v): Negative (`Fail Definition`) and paired positive (`Example ... := eq_refl`) controls verifying that proof-checking cannot promote unattested or self-attested `IntentAdequacy` claims.
- [tests/ExportVectors.v](tests/ExportVectors.v): Evaluates canonical policy vectors `VEC-01` through `VEC-08` via `Compute` for differential parity testing.

## Build & Package Metadata

- [Makefile](Makefile): Orchestrates `coq_makefile` compilation, forbidden-keyword grep checks (`Admitted`, `Axiom`, `Conjecture`, `Parameter`), `coqchk -o`, and the 7-theorem `Closed under the global context` CI gate via `make verify`.
- [_CoqProject](_CoqProject): Maps `theories` to `GenesisBoundary` and `tests` to `GenesisBoundaryTests`.
- [coq-specification-boundary.opam](coq-specification-boundary.opam): OPAM 2.0 package definition pinned to `coq {= "8.18.0"}`.
- [.github/workflows/coq.yml](.github/workflows/coq.yml): GitHub Actions CI pipeline executing `make verify` inside `coqorg/coq:8.18.0`.

## Explicit Scope Exclusions

- Does not solve the genesis problem or certify real-world semantic adequacy.
- Assumes soundness of the Coq 8.18.0 kernel and `coqchk` verifier.
- Makes no statistical or empirical claims about LLM translation accuracy.
- Provides no executable runtime monitor, resource/timing bounds, or physical actuation enforcement.
